easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Your library isn't empty.
description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Thunder of Unity and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
